primary_category.sound_quality: How sound itself is perceived (loudness, tone, feedback, distortion, own voice).
primary_category.speech_understanding: Difficulty understanding speech in a given setting.
primary_category.connectivity: Bluetooth, phone app, and streaming or accessory problems.
primary_category.discomfort: Physical comfort and fit in or on the ear.
primary_category.battery_charging: Battery life, charging, and charger problems.
primary_category.performance_practicality: Whether the device works, and day-to-day handling, cleaning, and appearance.
primary_category.other: Positive feedback, cost or service, unrelated questions, vague messages, and medical red flags.

sound_quality.too_loud: Sounds or overall volume uncomfortably loud.
sound_quality.too_soft: Sounds too quiet; patient can barely hear. No description of a dead or failing device.
sound_quality.tinny_or_harsh: Thin, sharp, high-pitched, or metallic tone.
sound_quality.own_voice_issue: Patient's own voice sounds boomy, echoey, or odd.
sound_quality.distortion_or_static: Crackling, buzzing, static, or garbled sound.
sound_quality.background_noise_annoying: Ambient noise itself is bothersome or overwhelming. The complaint is the noise, not understanding people.
sound_quality.other_sound_quality: Sound quality complaint that fits none of the above.

speech_understanding.speech_in_noise: Hard to understand people when there is background noise.
speech_understanding.speech_in_quiet: Hard to understand people in quiet settings.
speech_understanding.phone_calls: Hard to understand on calls. Not a dropout or connection problem.
speech_understanding.tv_or_media: Hard to understand speech on TV, movies, or other media.
speech_understanding.soft_or_distant_voices: Hard to hear quiet or far-away talkers.
speech_understanding.other_speech: Speech understanding complaint that fits none of the above.

connectivity.bluetooth_dropout: Connection to phone cuts out or is unstable.
connectivity.pairing_failure: Cannot pair or re-pair with a device.
connectivity.app_issue: Companion app crashes, shows wrong information, or controls do not respond.
connectivity.streaming_audio_quality: Streamed audio is too quiet, distant, or poor compared with normal hearing.
connectivity.other_connectivity: Other accessory or streamer problem (TV streamer, remote microphone).

discomfort.pain_or_pressure: Pain, soreness, or pressure while wearing the device.
discomfort.ear_fullness: Generic plugged or full feeling in the ear. Not specifically about own voice.
discomfort.other_discomfort: Discomfort that fits none of the above.

battery_charging.short_battery_life: Battery runs out sooner than expected.
battery_charging.charging_failure: Device will not charge or charger shows an error.
battery_charging.charger_issue: Seating, case, or charging-routine problem. Device itself may be fine.
battery_charging.unexpected_shutdown: Device turns off while the indicator still shows charge.
battery_charging.other_battery: Battery or charging issue that fits none of the above.

performance_practicality.device_not_working: Device is dead, silent, or intermittently powering on.
performance_practicality.moisture_or_wax_damage: Problem attributed to moisture, sweat, or wax.
performance_practicality.handling_difficulty: Hard to insert, remove, or operate (dexterity, small parts).
performance_practicality.cleaning_maintenance: Questions or problems about cleaning, wax guards, or upkeep.
performance_practicality.other_practicality: Practical issue that fits none of the above.

other.positive_feedback_no_issue: Positive message, no problem to solve.
other.cost_or_service: Pricing, billing, appointment access, or warranty.
other.unrelated_to_device: General hearing question or non-sudden tinnitus question. No red-flag symptoms.
other.sudden_hearing_change: Abrupt change in hearing over the last days, especially in one ear. Red flag.
other.unclear_or_insufficient_info: Too vague to assign a problem.

situation.tv_or_media: TV, movies, music, or streamed media.
situation.car_or_transit: In a car or on public transit.
situation.not_stated: Text does not indicate a setting.

suggested_action.adjust_programming: Fix likely through fitting software: gain, noise management, feedback manager, streaming balance.
suggested_action.physical_fit_adjustment: Fix likely through dome, earmold, tubing, vent, or seating change.
suggested_action.check_hardware_or_repair: Device inspection, cleaning, repair, or replacement.
suggested_action.troubleshoot_connectivity: Re-pairing, phone or app settings, updates.
suggested_action.user_education_or_counseling: Usage habits, handling, expectations, or non-urgent questions.
suggested_action.request_more_information: Message too vague to act on.
suggested_action.escalate_medical: Red flag. Needs clinician or medical evaluation.

urgency.routine: Comfort, preference, or optimization. No loss of function.
urgency.soon: Device not functioning, or patient has stopped wearing it. Resolve within days.
urgency.urgent: Possible medical red flag (sudden hearing change, severe pain, dizziness, discharge or bleeding). Must pair with escalate_medical.
